answer.evidence: RX drop from -11.7 dBm to -14.5 dBm on 2023-10-23 after patching work at B-ODF (site notes 11:43 UTC, alarm RX_LOW_WARNING 13:00 UTC). Power meter: A-TX +0.81 dBm, B-ODF -7.35 dBm => link loss 8.16 dB vs commissioning 5.41 dB (+2.75 dB), B-ODF to B-RX 7.02 dB = correct 7 dB attenuator. OTDR bidirectional: B-ODF loss 2.92 dB (1550 A-side), 2.90 dB (1550 B-side), 2.80 dB (1310 A-side) vs ~0.27 dB expected / A-ODF 0.27 dB clean — wavelength-independent reflective loss. Inspection-scope B-ODF shows heavy contamination (black spots on cladding/ferrule) while A-ODF and MID-PP are clean. All points to dirt introduced during patching at B-ODF.
